summary: Forbid one-time login return credentials from appearing in browser address-bar query strings or fragments and require URL-clean return transport.
approvalBasis: The EKODI Platform Super Administrator explicitly instructed that one-time authentication values used for login return must never be displayed in the browser address bar and that this must become a forced execution rule.

requirements: One-time login return credentials must never be transported in URL query parameters or fragments.
Login return credentials must use POST body transport or an equivalent server-side session handoff that does not expose the credential in the address bar.
The destination must consume the one-time credential before rendering the normal target surface.
history.replaceState is defense in depth only and may not be used as the primary justification for credential-bearing URL transport.
Referrer leakage of login return credentials is forbidden.
The rule applies to current and future sites, admin surfaces, boards and descendant routes with no per-site opt-out.

verification: static rejection of query/fragment one-time credential generation
guarded deployment and production login-return verification
